title: Best Robotic Arm (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were based on mentions in PCMag (source 0), CNET (source 1) and Consumer Reports (source 2). Products recommended by multiple sources were prioritized.
assumptions: No price information was omitted; only the $2,599 price from CNET was used.

verdict.pick: Roborock Saros Z70 Robotic Vacuum and Mop with OmniGrip Mechanical Arm
verdict.line: Ideal for tech‑enthusiasts who want a vacuum that can also pick up small items. It offers strong vacuuming, mopping, and mapping plus the unique OmniGrip arm, though the arm still has reliability issues.
